author: CottleMan89
quote:
GTA IN NAME ONLY!

I don't what this game is but it's not grand theft auto.
It has quite literally stripped away everything that made GTA the series it is and replaced it with dull, humourless, slop and a relationship simulator.

The storylines is flat.
The missions are easy and boring
The characters are dull and lifeless
The driving system **** so does the UI, free aim, and wanted system.
If I wanted to spend 10 hours of gameplay doing chores I'd play the Sims. 
Imagine a game called grand theft auto that doesnt let you steal the cars you want to steal. Imagine a game where you can stomp a dog to death but cant slap a protestor because their ideology needs coddling. There's a clear political agenda to this game and the critic reviews are obviously bought and paid for.

2/10
